key_insights: Cred strongly criticizes the 'spot premium is bullish' narrative as fundamentally flawed - in downtrend conditions, spot selling causes futures to sell harder due to liquidations, creating the discount not bullish demand
Monthly timeframe breakdown on BTC and ETH is a serious bearish signal worth taking seriously - options are reclaim, buy cheaper, or wait for new structure
Crypto showing specific weakness vs S&P 500 - S&P trading at early May levels while BTC is much lower, indicating decorrelation to downside which is particularly bearish for crypto
Alts down 80-90% in bear markets is a recurring pattern every single cycle - 'something that happens every single cycle and it's not going to change right'
Bear markets are when fundamentals matter (network outages, scaling issues) as opposed to bull markets when problems are ignored
Large exchanges (Coinbase, Gemini) freezing hiring and laying off staff suggests they expect extended bear market of 6-18 months
Previous cycle darlings (SOL, LUNA, AVAX, AXIE) are 'dead' in USD and BTC terms - major headwinds for crypto
Three trading approaches after range breakdown: 1) Call BS and buy reclaim of 35-37k, 2) Wait for turbo nuke to buy cheaper at $20k or $14k, 3) Wait for new structure to form over weeks/months
